opinions.text: C. A. 7th Cir. [Cer-­tiorari granted, ante, p. 1057.] Motion of petitioner for appoint­ment of counsel granted. Stephen E. Eberhardt, Esq., of Tinley Park, Ill., is appointed to serve as counsel for petitioner in this case.
